purpose: Qualify full recovered NetLogo model with explicit pollution settings; not an authenticated historical preset or a qualitative replication.
native_preset: preset1 plus useP? true, pollutionRate 1, useD? true, diffusionRate 1: 400 scattered agents, metabolism 1..4, vision 1..6, sugar growback 1 each tick
diagnostic: Haskell uses self plus four-neighbor averaging; candidate diffuse uses eight neighbors. These are not matched diffusion kernels. Pollution offset representation is recorded separately.
observer: Existing with-local-randomness reporters; plain versus observed population must match at all 1001 frames.
